hooks.command: CMD=$(node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/parse-input.js" command); echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|DROP TABLE|sudo rm' && { echo 'Blocked dangerous command' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

FP=$(node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/parse-input.js" file_path); [ -z "$FP" ] && exit 0; BN=$(basename "$FP"); case "$BN" in .env|.env.*) [ "$BN" = ".env.example" ] || { echo "Blocked write to env file: $FP" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; case "$FP" in *serviceAccount*.json|*-credentials*.json) echo "Blocked write to credentials file: $FP" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
FP=$(node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/parse-input.js" file_path); echo "$FP" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$' && npx --no-install eslint --fix "$FP" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
mkdir -p ~/.claude 2>/dev/null; echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') session ended in $(pwd)" >> ~/.claude/aretae-sessions.log 2>/dev/null; exit 0
